section: National - economy: Union Budget and Economic Survey highlights, RBI policy, key data releases
subsections: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes
Landmark economic decisions - announcement date and scope
GST Council decisions - rate changes, collections, meeting number

accepted.s: As at August 2026, which one of the following correctly represents the RBI policy rates and stance?
o: Repo rate 5.00%, SDF 5.50%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.25%, with a calibrated tightening stance
Repo rate 5.25%, SDF 5.50%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.00%, with a withdrawal-of-accommodation stance
Repo rate 5.50%, SDF 5.25%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.00%, with an accommodative stance
Repo rate 5.25%, SDF 5.00%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.50%, with a neutral stance
accepted.x: In August 2026, the repo rate was 5.25%, the SDF was 5.00%, the MSF and Bank Rate were 5.50%, and the monetary policy stance was neutral.
accepted.tq: Use the comparison table and distinguish the floor rate from the ceiling rates.

accepted.s: The repo rate was reduced by 25 basis points in December 2025. What was its rate after this reduction?
accepted.x: The repo rate became 5.25% after a 25-basis-point cut in December 2025 and remained unchanged in February, June and August 2026.
accepted.tq: Convert the basis-point change into the resulting policy rate.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR):
1. It was reduced by 100 basis points.
2. It stood at 3% of Net Demand and Time Liabilities.
3. It is the same as the Statutory Liquidity Ratio.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The CRR was cut by 100 basis points to 3% of NDTL. CRR and SLR are distinct requirements, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise numerical facts and reject the swapped concept.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF)?
o: It is the floor of the Liquidity Adjustment Facility corridor and operates in place of the reverse repo.
It is the ceiling of the Liquidity Adjustment Facility corridor and replaced the repo rate.
It is the statutory reserve maintained by banks with the RBI.
It is the rate at which the RBI lends overnight funds to the Union Government.
accepted.x: The SDF, at 5.00%, is the floor of the LAF corridor and operates in place of the reverse repo rate.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the floor and ceiling of the monetary-policy corridor.

accepted.s:
With reference to the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC), consider the following statements:
1. It consists of six members.
2. The Governor of the RBI chairs it and has a casting vote.
3. All its members are appointed by the RBI.
4. It must meet at least four times a year.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The MPC has six members, is chaired by the RBI Governor who has a casting vote, and must meet at least four times a year. Three members are appointed by the Centre, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Split the composition, appointment and procedural statements before selecting the code.

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct composition of the six-member Monetary Policy Committee?
o: Governor, three Deputy Governors and two external members
Finance Minister, RBI Governor, two Deputy Governors and two external members
Governor, one Deputy Governor, one RBI officer and three external members
Governor, two Deputy Governors, one Finance Ministry officer and two external members
accepted.x: The MPC comprises the RBI Governor, one Deputy Governor, one RBI officer and three external members.
accepted.tq: Use the membership-count trap and check the institutional source of each member.

accepted.s: The external members of the Monetary Policy Committee hold office for a term of:
accepted.x: The three external members of the MPC have four-year terms.
accepted.tq: Recall the fixed tenure rather than confusing it with the inflation-target cycle.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Section 45ZN — failure to meet the inflation target
Section 45ZN — appointment of external MPC members
accepted.x: Section 45ZB creates the MPC, Section 45ZA concerns the inflation target, and Section 45ZN deals with failure to meet the target.
accepted.tq: Match each statutory section with its exact monetary-policy function.

accepted.s: Under the flexible inflation-targeting framework, the CPI inflation target is:
accepted.x: The target is 4% with a tolerance band of plus or minus 2%, making the permitted band 2% to 6%.
accepted.tq: Separate the central target from the permissible tolerance band.

accepted.s: The inflation target under Section 45ZA is reviewed and set once every:
accepted.x: The inflation target of 4% with a tolerance band of ±2% is set every five years.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the five-year target cycle from the four-year tenure of external members.

accepted.s: Under the failure clause relating to the inflation target, the target is considered to have been missed when inflation remains outside the tolerance band for:
accepted.x: Failure to meet the inflation target under Section 45ZN is associated with inflation remaining outside the band for three consecutive quarters.
accepted.tq: Reject the older month-based formulation and identify the current quarter-based condition.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about RBI monetary policy during 2026:
1. The repo rate was held at 5.25% in February, April, June and August.
2. The August 2026 decision was the fourth consecutive hold.
3. The August decision was unanimous.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The repo rate remained at 5.25% in all four listed 2026 meetings; August represented the fourth consecutive hold and the decision was unanimous.
accepted.tq: Check the sequence, count and character of the policy decisions together.

accepted.s: The December 2025 monetary-policy package included which of the following measures?
o: A complete suspension of open-market operations and a 5-billion-dollar loan
₹1 lakh crore of open-market sales and a 5-billion-dollar currency auction
₹10,000 crore of open-market purchases and a 50-billion-dollar swap
₹1 lakh crore of open-market purchases and a 5-billion-dollar buy-sell swap
accepted.x: The December 2025 package comprised ₹1 lakh crore of OMO purchases and a 5-billion-dollar buy-sell swap.
accepted.tq: Match the monetary instrument with its amount and direction.

accepted.s: The cumulative repo-rate reduction since February 2025, reaching 5.25% in December 2025, was:
accepted.x: The easing cycle involved a cumulative reduction of 125 basis points since February 2025.
accepted.tq: Use the cumulative-change figure rather than inferring it from a single meeting.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the latest MPC projections mentioned for 2026-27?
o: Real GDP growth 6.6% and CPI inflation 4.5%
Real GDP growth 6.7% and CPI inflation 5.1%
Real GDP growth 5.1% and CPI inflation 6.7%
Real GDP growth 6.9% and CPI inflation 4.5%
accepted.x: The August 2026 projection for real GDP growth was 6.7%, while the June 2026 CPI projection was 5.1%.
accepted.tq: Read the latest value in each column and avoid substituting earlier projections.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the sequence of real GDP projections for 2026-27 in April, June and August 2026?
accepted.x: The real GDP projection was 6.9% in April, 6.6% in June and 6.7% in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Arrange the dated projections in time before comparing the figures.

accepted.s: Which institution prepares the Union Budget?
o: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
accepted.x: The Union Budget is prepared by the Department of Economic Affairs under the Ministry of Finance.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry-department distinction to avoid a neighbouring-body swap.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Article 112 of the Constitution refers to the:
accepted.x: Article 112 provides for the Annual Financial Statement. The Constitution does not use the term “Budget” as the formal title.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the popular term Budget and the constitutional expression Annual Financial Statement.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The fiscal deficit target in Union Budget 2026-27 was:
o: 3.9% of GDP, amounting to ₹15.96 lakh crore
4.4% of GDP, amounting to ₹17.96 lakh crore
4.3% of GDP, amounting to ₹16.96 lakh crore
4.8% of GDP, amounting to ₹16.96 lakh crore
accepted.x: The fiscal deficit was targeted at 4.3% of GDP, equivalent to ₹16.96 lakh crore, compared with 4.4% in FY 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Match the percentage with its corresponding rupee amount.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Container manufacturing — ₹10,000 crore over five years
Biopharma SHAKTI — ₹20,000 crore over five years
Infrastructure Risk Guarantee Fund — partial credit guarantees to lenders
accepted.x: Biopharma SHAKTI was allocated ₹10,000 crore over five years. ₹20,000 crore over five years was provided for CCUS.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped amount by matching each fund with its stated allocation.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Self-Reliant India Fund was topped up by:
accepted.x: The Self-Reliant India Fund received a top-up of ₹2,000 crore alongside the SME Growth Fund.
accepted.tq: Recall the specific top-up amount rather than the larger headline fund allocation.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes ISM 2.0 in Union Budget 2026-27?
o: It finances only container manufacturing in coastal States.
It provides crop insurance and irrigation support to small farmers.
It establishes a universal urban housing subsidy.
It focuses on equipment, materials and full-stack Indian intellectual property.
accepted.x: ISM 2.0 covers equipment, materials and full-stack Indian intellectual property.
accepted.tq: Identify the scheme’s scope rather than its funding amount.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following tax changes was announced for implementation from 1 April 2026?
o: STT on futures reduced from 0.05% to 0.02%.
The new Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force.
accepted.x: The new Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 April 2026. MAT was reduced to 14%, while STT rates on futures and options were increased.
accepted.tq: Use the commencement date and reject reversals in tax-rate changes.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the revised securities transaction tax rates?
accepted.x: STT on futures was increased to 0.05% and on options to 0.15%.
accepted.tq: Keep the futures and options rates paired in the correct order.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF) was announced in:
accepted.x: UIDF was announced in Union Budget 2023-24.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the year of announcement from the year of later reference or implementation.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about UIDF:
1. It is funded from the shortfall in priority-sector lending.
2. It is operated by the National Housing Bank.
3. It is intended for Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.
4. It provides ₹10,000 crore every year and ₹30,000 crore in total for FY 2024-FY 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe UIDF’s funding source, implementing institution, target cities and stated allocations.
accepted.tq: Verify each institutional, geographic and numerical feature before choosing the complete code.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which State was stated to have taken about ₹4,000 crore from UIDF?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh was stated to have taken approximately ₹4,000 crore from UIDF.
accepted.tq: Apply the AP-specific angle and distinguish the State from neighbouring options.
accepted.sec: Union Budget - new funds and schemes, fiscal deficit target, tax changes  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Demonetisation on 8 November 2016 related principally to the withdrawal of which notes?
accepted.x: The demonetisation decision announced on 8 November 2016 withdrew ₹500 and ₹1,000 banknotes.
accepted.tq: Match the announcement date with the exact denominations affected.
accepted.sec: Landmark economic decisions - announcement date and scope  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Goods and Services Tax was rolled out in India on:
accepted.x: GST was rolled out on 1 July 2017 under the constitutional framework created by the 101st Amendment Act, 2016.
accepted.tq: Separate the amendment year from the actual rollout date.
accepted.sec: Landmark economic decisions - announcement date and scope  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes GST 2.0?
o: It was approved at the 56th GST Council meeting on 3 September 2025 and came into force on 22 September 2025.
It was approved at the 57th GST Council meeting on 12 September 2026 and came into force immediately.
It was introduced on 1 July 2017 under the 101st Amendment Act.
It was announced on 8 November 2016 along with demonetisation.
accepted.x: GST 2.0 was decided at the 56th GST Council meeting on 3 September 2025 and took effect on 22 September 2025.
accepted.tq: Match the decision date, meeting number and implementation date.
accepted.sec: Landmark economic decisions - announcement date and scope  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Under GST 2.0, which rate structure was adopted?
accepted.x: GST 2.0 adopted slabs of 0%, 5%, 18% and 40%; the 12% and 28% slabs were abolished.
accepted.tq: Identify the retained and newly applicable slabs while spotting the abolished rates.
accepted.sec: Landmark economic decisions - announcement date and scope  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Flexible inflation targeting in India was introduced in 2016 through the:
o: RBI (Amendment) Act, with the Urjit Patel Committee having submitted its report in 2014
Finance Act, with the Kelkar Committee having submitted its report in 2016
101st Constitutional Amendment Act, with the Urjit Patel Committee having reported in 2017
Banking Regulation Act, with the Narasimham Committee having reported in 2014
accepted.x: Flexible inflation targeting was introduced in 2016 through the RBI (Amendment) Act, following the Urjit Patel Committee’s 2014 recommendations.
accepted.tq: Pair the policy with both its legal instrument and recommending committee.
accepted.sec: Landmark economic decisions - announcement date and scope  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the GST Council:
1. It is constituted under Article 279A.
2. It is chaired by the Union Finance Minister.
3. The Centre has one-third of the weighted vote and the States together have two-thirds.
4. Decisions require a three-fourths majority.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the constitutional basis, chairperson, voting distribution and decision threshold of the GST Council.
accepted.tq: Check constitutional article, chairperson, voting weights and threshold as separate elements.
accepted.sec: GST Council decisions - rate changes, collections, meeting number  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following was a decision of the 56th GST Council meeting held on 3 September 2025?
o: A return to four principal slabs of 0%, 5%, 12% and 28%
Two principal slabs of 5% and 18%, with a 40% demerit rate
A single uniform GST rate of 18%
Complete abolition of compensation cess, including on tobacco
accepted.x: The 56th meeting adopted two main slabs of 5% and 18%, along with a 40% demerit rate. Compensation cess largely ended but continued on tobacco.
accepted.tq: Use the rate-structure and compensation-cess exceptions together.
accepted.sec: GST Council decisions - rate changes, collections, meeting number  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the GST Council’s 57th meeting is correct?
o: It was scheduled for 1 July 2026 in Hyderabad after a gap of one month.
It was held on 3 September 2025 in Mumbai.
It was held on 22 September 2025 in New Delhi.
It was scheduled for 12 September 2026 in New Delhi after a gap of more than a year.
accepted.x: The 57th GST Council meeting was scheduled for 12 September 2026 in New Delhi after a gap of more than a year.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a scheduled meeting from the preceding meeting and implementation date.
accepted.sec: GST Council decisions - rate changes, collections, meeting number  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the GST collection figures mentioned for 2026?
o: ₹2.43 lakh crore in April and ₹1,99,853 crore gross in August
₹1,51,000 crore in April and ₹2.43 lakh crore gross in August
₹2.43 lakh crore in August and ₹1,51,000 crore gross in April
₹1.99 lakh crore in April and ₹2,43,000 crore gross in August
accepted.x: GST collections reached a record ₹2.43 lakh crore in April 2026, while gross collections in August 2026 were ₹1,99,853 crore, up 14.8%.
accepted.tq: Match each collection figure with its month and distinguish lakh-crore from crore notation.
accepted.sec: GST Council decisions - rate changes, collections, meeting number  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The taxpayer base under GST was reported to be approximately:
accepted.x: The GST taxpayer base was reported at approximately 1.51 crore in 2025.
accepted.tq: Read the magnitude carefully and reject the nearby digit trap.
accepted.sec: GST Council decisions - rate changes, collections, meeting number  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: After rebasing, India’s GDP growth in the first quarter of FY 2026-27 and the corresponding CPI inflation were reported as:
accepted.x: After rebasing, GDP grew by 7.8% in Q1 FY27, while CPI inflation rose to 4.45%.
accepted.tq: Keep the growth figure and inflation figure in their correct order.

accepted.s: Which factor was associated with the rise in CPI to 4.45% after the Q1 FY27 GDP rebasing?
o: Higher oil prices linked to the West Asia situation
A fall in domestic food production alone
The abolition of the repo rate
accepted.x: The rise in CPI to 4.45% was associated with West Asia-related oil-price pressures.
accepted.tq: Link the stated external shock with its inflationary effect.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the economic data and debates is correct?
o: The new GDP series eliminated all debate over employment data.
Youth unemployment was reported at 14.8%, and the new series faced criticism over a downward revision of nominal GDP.
The new GDP series attracted criticism for an upward revision of nominal GDP.
accepted.x: The stated youth unemployment figure was 14.8% in PLFS 2025, while criticism focused on a downward revision of nominal GDP under the new series.
accepted.tq: Combine the correct numerical figure with the direction of the criticism.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly compares Andhra Pradesh’s retail inflation with the national rate mentioned for May 2026?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh’s CPI inflation was 4.9%, above the national rate of 3.9% mentioned for the comparison.
accepted.tq: Check the direction of the State-versus-national comparison before the figures.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh’s economy:
1. Its net GST growth in 2025-26 was 6%.
2. It faced a ₹4,500 crore impact from GST 2.0.
3. It was included in the Budget’s Rare Earth Corridors.
4. Its retail inflation was below the national rate.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: AP recorded 6% net GST growth, faced a ₹4,500 crore GST 2.0 impact and was included in the Rare Earth Corridors. Its inflation was above, not below, the national rate, so statement 4 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the reversed comparison in the AP-specific statement set.

accepted.s: Which institutions were associated with loans relevant to Andhra Pradesh’s development initiatives?
o: World Bank through SALT and Asian Development Bank through VCIC
IMF through SALT and World Bank through VCIC
ADB through SALT and IMF through VCIC
UNDP through SALT and World Bank through GST 2.0
accepted.x: The World Bank was associated with SALT, while the Asian Development Bank was associated with VCIC loans.
accepted.tq: Match each acronym with the correct international financial institution.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements reflects the current monetary and payments-related developments mentioned?
o: UPI MDR began in February 2025, and the August 2026 rate hike had already occurred.
UPI MDR was expected from 15 October 2026, and a rate hike was considered likely in October 2026.
UPI MDR was introduced with GST 2.0 in September 2025, and no policy change was expected.
UPI MDR was abolished from 15 October 2026, and a rate cut was certain in October 2026.
accepted.x: A change relating to UPI MDR was expected from 15 October 2026, while an October 2026 rate hike was considered likely after the inflation developments.
accepted.tq: Separate an expected future development from a completed policy action.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the first RBI rate cut since May 2020?
o: It occurred in February 2025 at the 53rd MPC meeting.
It occurred in December 2025 at the 56th MPC meeting.
It occurred in June 2025 at the 52nd MPC meeting.
It occurred in August 2026 at the 57th MPC meeting.
accepted.x: The first RBI rate cut since May 2020 took place in February 2025 at the 53rd MPC meeting.
accepted.tq: Match the policy milestone with its month and MPC meeting number.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with respect to UPI internationalisation?
o: Uzbekistan — first UPI country; Bhutan — eleventh UPI country
Uzbekistan — eleventh UPI country; Bhutan — first UPI country
Uzbekistan — fifth UPI country; Bhutan — second UPI country
Uzbekistan — tenth UPI country; Bhutan — third UPI country
accepted.x: Uzbekistan became the 11th country to adopt UPI, while Bhutan was the first UPI country.
accepted.tq: Use the ordinal-number trap in a two-country comparison.
